title: HIVEM1ND 3.0: Relay LAN and Relay+
note: The setup and Settings screens of ReLAN, the transport over the local network with no account, and Relay+, the transport through the Cosmic account, for the owner to approve before the GUI is built. Each machine keeps its own copy of the M1ND; any machine can host, and hosting moves when the host leaves or with Host here. The sample is invented.
